name: Saka's Barbershop
tagline: Clean fades and an unhurried shave in Woodlands.

hero.headline: The full chair, not a quick gap.
hero.blurb: Fades and shaves are booked for the whole sitting. The time you pick is the time the chair is yours.

policies.title: Deposits
policies.body: The demo may show a sample hold in kwacha. Nothing is charged, and the chair is only saved in this browser.

policies.title: Lateness
policies.body: Sample note: arrive within 10 minutes. A late start may mean a shorter cut if the next guest is waiting.

policies.title: Cancellations
policies.body: Sample note: tell the shop the day before if you cannot come. Same-day misses can be marked as a no-show in the demo.

policies.title: What to bring
policies.body: Sample note: bring a photo of the cut you want. The shop supplies the cape and tools.

categories.name: Cuts
categories.blurb: Fades and classic cuts. The chair is yours for the full slot.

services.name: Skin fade
services.description: A tight fade, scissor work on top and a clean lineup.

services.name: Classic cut
services.description: A straightforward cut and style, no skin fade.

services.name: Kids cut
services.description: A patient cut for children under 12, with a simple finish.

categories.name: Beard
categories.blurb: Shape-ups and a hot towel shave.

services.name: Beard shape
services.description: Line, shape and a short beard oil finish.

services.name: Hot towel shave
services.description: A traditional shave with hot towels. Allow half an hour.

categories.name: Packages
categories.blurb: Longer visits when you want the cut and the beard together.

services.name: Cut and beard
services.description: Skin fade or classic cut plus a beard shape in one hour.

services.name: Scalp treatment
services.description: A short treatment for a dry or itchy scalp, after a consultation.
